content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Bloomberg's PostBloomberg Verified account3d · Shared with PublicTwo years ago, Peter Magyar declared that he was resigning from his state job in protest against a system that, he said, had made families around Prime Minister Viktor Orban rich at the expense of other Hungarians. Now he's on the brink of ending the regime.Read more about the former party insider who is about to become Hungary's next leader: https://bloom.bg/4vnM2uC: Darko Bandic/AP PhotoAll reactions:7.8K530 comments307 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Robert BirtalanLegendary win.
